parameters.query:
WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.* FROM public.route_b_pm_l3_decisions d
WHERE d.decision_type='request_github_execution_package'
AND d.decision_payload_json?'github_execution_request_json'
AND NOT(d.decision_payload_json?'github_executor_dispatch')
AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,repository_full_name}'='Viktoryyyyy/moex-robot'
AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,requested_by_role}'='PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER'
AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,base_ref}'='origin/main'
AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,branch_name}' LIKE 'n8n/%'
AND jsonb_array_length(d.decision_payload_json#>'{github_execution_request_json,approved_file_scope}')=1
AND jsonb_array_length(d.decision_payload_json#>'{github_execution_request_json,file_changes}')=1
AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,file_changes,0,path}'=d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,approved_file_scope,0}'
AND lower(d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_execution_request_json,file_changes,0,operation}') IN('create','update')
AND d.authority_boundary_json->>'merge_authority'='PM_L2_ONLY'
AND d.authority_boundary_json@>'{"n8n_merge_allowed":false,"direct_main_write_allowed":false,"force_push_allowed":false,"file_delete_allowed":false,"executor_merge_allowed":false,"runtime_live_trading_allowed":false,"broker_execution_allowed":false,"server_apply_allowed":false,"production_secret_access_allowed":false}'::jsonb
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.route_b_role_outputs o WHERE o.phase_run_id=d.phase_run_id AND o.workflow_run_id=d.workflow_run_id AND o.role_task_id=d.role_task_id AND o.role_id='PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER' AND o.validation_status IN('pass','conditional_pass'))
ORDER BY d.created_at,d.pm_l3_decision_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1),
u AS(
UPDATE public.route_b_pm_l3_decisions d SET decision_payload_json=jsonb_set(d.decision_payload_json,'{github_executor_dispatch}',jsonb_build_object('status','claimed','claim_token',md5(clock_timestamp()::text||random()::text),'attempt',1,'claimed_at',now(),'automatic_replay_allowed',false),true)
FROM c WHERE d.pm_l3_decision_id=c.pm_l3_decision_id RETURNING d.*)
SELECT * FROM u;

parameters.jsCode: const c=$node['Prepare Intake Envelope'].json,i=$node['Call Executor Intake'].json,m=$json,s=i.normalized_github_execution_request_json;if(i.accepted!==true||i.validation_status!=='pass'||!s)throw new Error('executor_intake_rejected');if(!m.object||!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(String(m.object.sha||'')))throw new Error('current_main_ref_invalid');if(!String(s.branch_name||'').startsWith('n8n/'))throw new Error('normalized_branch_not_n8n');s.execution_request_id=c.request.execution_request_id;s.workflow_run_id=c.request.workflow_run_id;s.phase_run_id=c.request.phase_run_id;s.role_task_id=c.request.role_task_id;s.pm_l3_decision_id=c.request.pm_l3_decision_id;s.file_changes=c.request.file_changes;s.base_sha=m.object.sha;s.file_delete_allowed=false;s.ci_required=true;s.expected_ci_workflow='tests';return[{json:{...c,normalized:s,runtime_body:{accepted:true,validation_status:'pass',normalized_github_execution_request_json:s}}}];

parameters.query: WITH p AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),u AS(UPDATE public.route_b_pm_l3_decisions d SET decision_payload_json=jsonb_set(d.decision_payload_json,'{github_executor_dispatch}',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('status',j->>'status','claim_token',j->>'claim_token','execution_request_id',j->>'execution_request_id','attempt',1,'completed_at',j->'completed_at','automatic_replay_allowed',false,'runtime_result',j->'runtime_result','error',j->'error')),true) FROM p WHERE d.pm_l3_decision_id=j->>'pm_l3_decision_id' AND d.decision_payload_json#>>'{github_executor_dispatch,claim_token}'=j->>'claim_token' RETURNING d.pm_l3_decision_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) persisted,(SELECT j FROM p) payload;
